Package com.hkust.marketplace.models

Class BorrowRequest

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.models.Offer
com.hkust.marketplace.models.BorrowRequest
public class BorrowRequest extends Offer
A request to borrow a lend listing for a period (BorrowRequest in the domain class diagram).

    • formatBorrowTime

      public static String formatBorrowTime(LocalDateTime time)
      A borrow time to the second, as screens and notifications show it: "14 Nov 2026 14:06:44". Borrowing works to the second (the shortest loan is MIN_BORROW_TIME), so a time shown to the minute would make an item that is returned on time look late (regression log R9).
